method: Demucs htdemucs --two-stems=vocals (speech stem V, accompaniment/SFX stem N) -> speech frame set from V voice-band VAD + whisper word timeline + SRT captions (dilated 60ms, gaps<=150ms merged, intro <2.3s exempt) -> speech-dominant frames (N_env/(N_env+V_env)<=0.5) hard-gated to digital zero, SFX-dominant frames (r>0.5, e.g. boings/pops overlapping words) kept at full level -> magnitude-only Wiener mask |N|^2/(|N|^2+4|V|^2) on N's STFT inside speech+/-150ms with N's own phase kept -> 30ms smoothed gate -> intro bed 0-2.3s from original mix -> zero-phase FFT highpass 30Hz -> peak normalize 0.95
phase: magnitude-only STFT masks + real time-domain envelopes; no L-R/mid-side processing; output waveform cos-sim vs no_vocals stem = 0.98-1.0 in kept SFX frames
speech_bleed: hard-gated speech frames are digital silence (max residual 4.7e-3 only at 30ms ramp edges adjacent to kept SFX); corr(output, vocals stem) in gated frames = -0.0016
